items.wrong: If it will rain, we will stay.
items.fix: If it rains, we will stay.
items.why: After if, use the present, not will.

items.wrong: When I will arrive, I will call you.
items.fix: When I arrive, I will call you.
items.why: After when, use the present for the future.

items.wrong: I call you as soon as I see it.
items.fix: I will call you as soon as I see it.

facts.big: If/when/as soon as + presente, will + verbo
facts.label: Planos com 1º condicional
facts.sub: Depois de if, when e as soon as, use o presente simples e coloque will no resultado: If it rains, we will stay. As soon as I arrive, I will call you.

facts.label: If + presente
facts.sub: Para planos que podem acontecer, use If + presente e will + verbo: If it rains, we will stay. Não use will na parte com If. Isso vale para qualquer situação possível no futuro.

facts.label: When
facts.sub: Use when para algo que vai acontecer com certeza: When I get up, I’ll cook. Depois de when, o verbo fica no presente, e a outra parte usa will. A ordem das partes pode mudar.

mini.en: Yes, if it {doesn’t rain|is sunny|is warm}. The forecast isn’t very good.
mini.pt: Vamos, se {não chover|fizer sol|fizer calor}. A previsão não está muito boa.

mini.en: If it rains, we will {stay at my place|go to the cinema|visit a museum} and cook.
mini.pt: Se chover, {ficaremos na minha casa|iremos ao cinema|visitaremos um museu} e cozinharemos.

mini.en: And if it’s sunny, we’ll have {a picnic|a barbecue|a game} by the lake.
mini.pt: E se fizer sol, faremos {um piquenique|um churrasco|um jogo} no lago.

mini.en: I’ll make {sandwiches|a salad|a cake} when I get up in the morning.
mini.pt: Vou fazer {sanduíches|uma salada|um bolo} quando acordar de manhã.

solo: Pergunte em que situação o aluno já passou por isso.

facts.label: As soon as
facts.sub: As soon as significa assim que: I’ll call you as soon as I arrive. O verbo depois de as soon as fica no presente. É muito comum em mensagens e planos entre amigos.

facts.label: Plano B
facts.sub: Use if para planos alternativos: If it’s sunny, we’ll go to the lake. If it rains, we’ll stay inside. Assim você mostra duas opções. Use or para ligar as duas.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: After if, we use the present for the future.

items.why: We use the present: If it rains.

items.s: “As soon as I get home, I’ll call you” is correct.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.

answers: After if, we use the present for the future. → Verdadeiro (Yes, If it rains.)
After if, we use will. → Falso (We use the present: If it rains.)

pages.title: A city park · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cloudy Thursday in Seattle. Dot and Dan sit on a bench in the park. Ducks swim slowly on the pond. A cool wind moves the tall trees. They want to plan their Saturday. But the weather can change fast here.
“Dan, are we still going to the park on Saturday?” says Dot. “Yes, if it doesn’t rain. The forecast isn’t very good.” says Dan. “If it rains, we will stay at my place and cook.” says Dot.
